claim: First device execution of Minus 7 and of Minus 3 on the Moto g56. Until today every committed winner was minus-toys and the device lane had executed exactly one of the eight community strategies. Minus 7 reached 6 AM on Night 1 and Minus Toys on Night 2, advancing the story save from Night 1 to Night 3; Minus 3 was executed twice on Night 3, its canonical night, and died both times. All four runs were --machine-only: an explicit MODEL_ONLY machine-input experiment with claim promotion suppressed, because no qualification is bound to these winners.
findings: Minus 7's Night 1 6 AM is not evidence for the route. recipe.mjs's own idleUntilMs() records that Foxy, BB, Mangle, the Withereds and Golden Freddy never act on Night 1, and the plan idles to 2 AM for that reason. The run graded 119 of 326 presses MISSING with two SYSTEMATIC misses on the maskraise (maskOn->false on 48 of 55 cycles, monitorUp->true on 54 of 55), while the rules read both states hundreds of times elsewhere in the same run. It reached 6 AM because nothing on Night 1 can punish a blind pilot.

Cause of those misses: the engine drops input during the mask-ON animation (MASK_ANIM_ON, 200 ms) exactly as during mask-off, and artifact-commands.mjs gated only mask-off. minus7's read presses the mask on at +1007 ms and its maskraise took it off at +1140 ms, 133 ms inside that window.

Minus 3 died twice in two Night 3 runs at 199.5 s and 399.6 s, the second to Balloon Boy plus Foxy. The pre-declared death prediction for that winner is 2974/3000 (99.1%) with inside-office as its ONLY killer; the model never produces a Foxy or BB death on this route. Two deaths at p=0.0087 is about 1 in 13,000, so the residual is systematic, not variance.

Leading mechanism for the Minus 3 deaths, not yet proven: Minus 3 is the only strategy that holds the right vent light (hallvent 400, about 40 times a night). pan-right-light-calibration-20260908 measured that held contacts near {2200,400} pan the office and that the vent light buttons move with the view, while the profile taps a fixed {2050,615} and no executor models pan state. The displaced buttons are exactly the Foxy reset and the vent check. Pedro observed heavy office panning during the run.

unknown.panOnsetMs: UNKNOWN(not-measured): the 2026-09-08 probe used 800 ms holds, the plan uses 400 ms, and the only evidence that 400 ms suffices is an unaided observation of the running phone.
unknown.minus3DeviceCause: UNKNOWN(not-isolated): the pan hypothesis is consistent with both deaths and with the killer the model cannot produce, but no run has yet measured pan displacement against a lost hall or vent contact.
